circularity_rule: A quantity used as a calibration criterion cannot be a primary H1 or H2 outcome. Primary outcomes are measured on held-out conditions.
controls: C-SIMPLE single threshold on angular size fitted with the same calibration budget

dry_run_subset.purpose: pipeline and sanity only, no H1 or H2 analysis

H1.exclude: standard aimed condition, speed 0.05 and offset 0 at every azimuth
metrics: left/right escape-group asymmetry for lateral strikes
walking bout and pause duration distributions

nulls.calibration_rule: same grid, seeds, criteria, budget and selection rule. No passing point: uncalibratable, retained in summary.

selection_rule: lowest no-threat whole-circuit rate; ties broken by s, kappa, nu0, gain in grid order

escape_standard.condition: aimed at the fly, standard speed
escape_standard.pass: escape onset before impact in 20% to 90% of strikes

false_escapes.pass: at most 0.05 escape onsets per second

not_saturated.pass: whole-circuit mean rate < 50 Hz and fewer than 5% of neurons above 150 Hz

not_silent.pass: whole-circuit mean rate >= 0.5 Hz and at least one decoder group rate > 0

spontaneous_movement.pass: E2 movement in 10% to 90% of control intervals

trial_design.criteria_aggregation: all no-threat criteria must pass for each seed; saturation per trial; standard escape fraction over all strikes and seeds; held-out trials excluded from calibration criteria
trial_design.dry_run_pose: sensory pose fixed at trial origin to keep standard strikes aimed; locomotor commands recorded; body runtime checked separately in C9
trial_design.escape_onset: rising edge of escape request; each consecutive run counts once; previous-held command drives current interval
trial_design.impact: integer neural ticks; no retroactive command application
trial_design.movement: abs(speed) >= 0.002 units/ms or abs(turn) >= 0.0005 rad/ms; previous-held applied command
trial_design.strike_reset: independent trial reset including neural state, body and decoder; state persists throughout each trial
